official_sources.title: Environment Agency LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles
official_sources.finding: Time-stamped DTM is bare-earth terrain, distributed as GeoTIFF in OS Grid/ODN metres; survey-period transformation and geoidal model are part of the metadata lineage.
official_sources.limitation: Dataset-level metadata does not prove the target parcel tile or its measured error.

official_sources.title: Environment Agency LIDAR Ground Truth Surveys
official_sources.finding: Independent ground-truth points carry survey date, method, transform/geoid metadata and +/-3cm RMSE point accuracy; target LiDAR surveys are compared by RMSE and random-error metrics.
official_sources.limitation: Ground truth must be matched to the actual target survey before any parcel accuracy claim.

official_sources.title: Environment Agency LIDAR DSM Time Stamped Tiles
official_sources.finding: DSM includes buildings, vegetation and vehicles and shares survey-period transformation metadata; it must remain distinct from bare-earth DTM.
official_sources.limitation: DSM cannot define terminal ground extrema.

official_sources.title: Environment Agency LIDAR Time Stamped Point Cloud
official_sources.finding: Timestamped point clouds contain XYZ and attributes and are the source from which gridded DTM/DSM products are derived; a matching point cloud is not guaranteed for every historic raster.
official_sources.limitation: Point-cloud availability alone does not establish canonical raster values.

official_sources.title: Environment Agency vertical accuracy FAQ
official_sources.finding: EA programme specifications require absolute vertical RMSE below +/-15cm and relative/random error no more than +/-5cm.
official_sources.limitation: Programme thresholds are not parcel-specific measured uncertainty.

official_sources.title: Environment Agency LIDAR Composite DTM 2m
official_sources.finding: Composite DTM merges multiple surveys and bilinearly resamples where necessary; metadata catalogues identify which survey contributed at a location.
official_sources.limitation: Composite values are derived and may mix epochs; native timestamped DTM is preferred when available.

official_sources.title: Environment Agency composite DTM transformation metadata
official_sources.finding: EA composite terrain data is in metres on ODN/OS Grid and uses OSTN15; survey index files identify contributing timestamped surveys.
official_sources.limitation: Composite metadata cannot replace target timestamped survey provenance.

official_sources.title: Environment Agency composite survey-period metadata
official_sources.finding: The 2022 composite contains surveys spanning 2000-2022, so survey epoch must be resolved per location rather than assumed from product publication year.
official_sources.limitation: The exact target survey still requires index lookup.

official_sources.title: Ordnance Survey OSTN15/OSGM15 accuracy
official_sources.finding: OSGM15 GB standard error is 0.008m excluding GNSS heighting error; transformation-model error must be a separate budget component.
official_sources.limitation: Transformation error is not LiDAR survey error or total parcel uncertainty.

official_sources.title: Ordnance Survey OS Net and GNSS FAQ
official_sources.finding: OSTN15/OSGM15 is the OS transformation between WGS84/ETRS89 and OSGB36/ODN; precise work must preserve the actual reference-frame provenance.
official_sources.limitation: A generic WGS84 label is insufficient for precision provenance.

official_sources.title: PROJ vertical grid shift
official_sources.finding: Vertical grid shifts depend on the selected grid, sign/multiplier and optionally observation/final epoch; grid priority and epoch are executable semantics.
official_sources.limitation: The correct GB grid/version must still be bound from target metadata.

official_sources.title: PROJ coordinate-operation factory controls
official_sources.finding: PROJ exposes minimum accuracy, ALLOW_BALLPARK=NO and ONLY_BEST=YES so missing best grids can fail instead of silently degrading.
official_sources.limitation: Runtime configuration must be captured and verified.

official_sources.title: PROJ cs2cs only-best and no-ballpark
official_sources.finding: --only-best errors when a grid required by the best transformation is missing; --no-ballpark rejects ballpark operations.
official_sources.limitation: CLI policy does not prove the application uses the same settings.

official_sources.title: PROJ coordinate operation computation
official_sources.finding: Operation selection considers requested accuracy, area of use, grid availability and known operation accuracy; local grid availability affects ranking.
official_sources.limitation: The chosen runtime operation must be logged, not inferred from CRS names.

official_sources.title: PROJ projinfo grid availability controls
official_sources.finding: projinfo can discard operations requiring missing grids or treat network-known grids differently; grid availability policy changes eligible operations.
official_sources.limitation: Network state and PROJ_DATA contents must be frozen for replay.

official_sources.title: PROJ grid transformation caveats
official_sources.finding: When multiple grids overlap, order matters and the first covering grid can be used; a null grid can permit zero-shift outside valid regions.
official_sources.limitation: Terminal processing must reject unintended zero-shift or wrong-priority grids.

official_sources.title: PROJ ballpark transformation glossary
official_sources.finding: Ballpark transformations do not perform the required datum shift and can have unknown errors, including tens of metres for vertical cases.
official_sources.limitation: This is a rejection rule, not a measured target error.

official_sources.title: GDAL Geotransform Tutorial
official_sources.finding: GDAL geotransform maps pixel/line to georeferenced coordinates; the upper-left pixel centre is at pixel/line 0.5,0.5 rather than the pixel corner.
official_sources.limitation: Dataset-specific geotransform still must be read from the actual raster.

official_sources.title: GDAL raster pixel-info
official_sources.finding: Pixel-info reports coordinate-to-column/line conversion, unscaled pixel values, contributing VRT files and explicit resampling mode.
official_sources.limitation: Interpolation modes other than nearest create derived values for point queries.

official_sources.title: GDAL RasterBand interpolation API
official_sources.finding: InterpolateAtPoint accepts fractional pixel/line coordinates and selectable interpolation, while RasterIO reads explicit integer windows; terminal native-pixel extraction must distinguish them.
official_sources.limitation: API capability does not itself determine the correct parcel sampling policy.
